text.description_html:
Acorn PR3YP, Ceramic Green Peas in a Pod Cabinet Knob

The Green Peas in a Pod Cabinet Knob are hand painted on ceramic so each one is a little work of art. It features three pea pods on a light green background. It measures 1-3/4 inches in diameter. This cabinet knob is sure to add a bit of whimsy to your kitchen.

Features of the Green Peas in a Pod Cabinet Knobs:

  • Diameter: 1-3/4"
  • Material: ceramic
  • Each design is hand painted on ceramic.
  • Package includes 1 knob and hardware for installation.

Sold Individually. Due to the hand painted nature of this product, the colors will vary slightly.
